resolvedFailedAttempts.failure: Realm fixture copied only enumerable globals, omitting native nonenumerable globals overwritten by injection such as XRWebGLLayer.
resolvedFailedAttempts.correction: Retain the explicit constructor list from each genuine injected document.

resolvedFailedAttempts.failure: Fixture supplied both baseLayer:null and layers in one render-state update, rejected by the existing API contract.
resolvedFailedAttempts.correction: Supply only layers; the existing render-state implementation clears baseLayer.

resolvedFailedAttempts.failure: MR CPU depth was queried before the real virtual room finished loading.
resolvedFailedAttempts.correction: Wait for actual AR room readiness before depth assertions, without substituting sensor/scene data.

resolvedFailedAttempts.failure: Popup hid the main document and Firefox ignored script window.focus(), correctly suspending its inline callbacks.
resolvedFailedAttempts.correction: Activate the actual main/popup window through WebDriver for the realm under test; preserve document visibility and inline suppression.
